record.question: Which of the following is NOT a Fundamental Duty?
options: to promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood
to promote international peace and security
record.explanation: Answer C: to promote international peace and security. Promoting international peace and security is a Directive Principle (Article 51), not a Fundamental Duty. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
